labels.heading: Heading
labels.use_description: Use the description when no value proposition is set
labels.bundle_use_recommendations: Use Shopify recommendations as a fallback

info.logo: Falls back to the shop name when empty.
info.announcement_text: Leave blank to hide the bar.
info.overlay_strength: Darkens the image so the text stays readable. The default of 40 gives light text a contrast of about 6 to 1 on a mid-grey photo; below 20 it can drop under 4.5 to 1.
info.hero_image: Without an image a placeholder is shown.
info.button_link: The button is hidden when the label is blank. Without a link it goes to all products.
info.collection_fallback: Falls back to all products when empty or unset.
info.tiles_fallback: Leave all four empty to show the first collections in the store.
info.item_blank: Leave blank to hide this item.
info.collection_pages: Applies to every collection page and the collection list.
info.autoplay_seconds: 0 turns autoplay off. Autoplay pauses on hover and focus, and is off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
info.slide_colors: Set both colours to override the theme gradient for this slide.
info.brands_fallback: With no brands added, the product vendors in your store are shown.
info.brand_link: Without a link it goes to all products.
info.suggested_terms: Comma-separated terms shown when the search box is focused and empty.
info.search_page_terms: Comma-separated terms shown on the search page before and when nothing matches.
info.product_tags: Per-product details use tags: badge:Bestseller, fact:Pack of 4, perk:Dishwasher safe. Ratings use the standard reviews.rating and reviews.rating_count metafields.
info.header_menu: Shown as the inline menu on desktop. On mobile, navigation is the bottom tab bar.
info.rating_block: Shows the average and count from your reviews. The count links to the reviews section. Hidden when there are no reviews.
info.price_block: Shows the price, the original price and the saving only when the product has a real compare-at price.
info.variant_block: Option buttons or swatches. Sold-out values are marked.
info.low_stock: Show "Only N left" at or below this number, for inventory-tracked variants only. 0 turns it off.
info.buy_now: Uses Shopify dynamic checkout; it only appears when it is enabled for your payment gateways.
info.delivery_blank: Leave blank to hide this line.
info.cod: A product can override this with the custom.cod_available metafield.
info.serviceable_prefixes: Comma-separated PIN prefixes you deliver to, for example 4, 56, 110. Leave blank to accept every PIN.
info.fast_prefixes: Comma-separated PIN prefixes that get the faster transit time.
info.transit_days: With dispatch days set, the checker shows an estimated delivery date range. Leave blank to show availability only.
info.trust_signals: Only add claims that are true for your store.
info.free_shipping_global: Amount in your store currency. Leave blank or 0 to hide free-shipping messaging.
info.offer_block: Create this code in Shopify admin > Discounts first. The theme cannot check that a code exists or what it applies to.
info.offer_title: For example: Extra 10% off your first order.
info.offer_details: Conditions, such as a minimum order value.
info.offer_percent: Shows "Get it for (price) with this code". Only set this if the code gives this exact percentage off this product.
info.offer_tag: Leave blank to show on every product.
info.specs_block: Rows come from the custom.specs metafield (one "Label: Value" per line), plus brand, type and weight.
info.tab_page: Used when the body text is empty.
info.product_recommendations: Shopify product recommendations. Complementary products are set up in the Search & Discovery app.
info.product_bundle: Products come from the custom.fbt metafield. Prices are the real variant prices; no bundle discount is shown.
info.bundle_use_recommendations: When custom.fbt is empty, show complementary products from the Search & Discovery app.
info.product_benefits: Uses the custom.benefits metafield (one benefit per line) when set, otherwise these blocks. Hidden when empty.
info.product_reviews: Reviews come from the custom.reviews metafield (product_review entries) or a review app (reviews.rating). Add a review app block below if you use one. Hidden when there are no reviews.
info.reviews_write_url: Optional. For example a contact page or your review app form.
info.product_faq: Shows questions from the custom.faq metafield, then these blocks. Hidden when empty.
info.recently_viewed: Products this shopper viewed on this device. Hidden for first-time visitors.
info.ribbons: Ribbons on the product image show combo offers from each product's custom.ribbons field (up to 3, for example "Buy 1 get 1 free" or "Buy 2 get 1 free"). They also appear in the offer marquee. Only add one when a matching discount is active in Shopify Discounts. Sales are shown by the marquee and the price, not as a ribbon.
info.feature_gallery: Shows the images from the product's custom.features entries as a full-width list. Hidden when the product has none.
info.offer_marquee: A red scrolling strip under the header listing this product's offers: the selected variant's sale, the offer codes above that apply to it, its custom.ribbons entries and the extra message. Hidden when there are none.
info.marquee_speed: Higher is faster. The pace stays the same however many messages there are.
info.marquee_text: Optional, for example "Free delivery on orders over Rs. 499". Only add claims you honour.
